objective: mean NDCG@10; ties prefer no cross-encoder, then earlier grid entry
test_policy: Freeze configuration before reading test judgments. Evaluate selected optimized system once on the same 300 test queries; no test-driven tuning.
primary_comparison: optimized minus original rerank NDCG@10; paired bootstrap 10000 resamples seed 42
scope: Query-to-paper retrieval only. Related-paper recommendations have no relevance judgments here.
